article.title: Food Scarcity In the Texas Prison System
article.author: LM Jackson
article.content: It's been an arduous day in the prison laundry, where I have spent the last four hours loading and unloading the three industrial-size dryers under my care. The one-ounce scoop of peanut butter served with two pieces of white bread and a one-ounce serving of canned fruit I received at breakfast failed to provide me with sufficient calories for the energy required to complete my task. Read more via Scalawag : Food Scarcity In the Texas Prison System .
